subject: I'm Not Sure
author: zerojay
body:
All I can tell you are the status of various bugs that have been posted. If there's been a bug posted about that particular challenge, I could probably prompt a response from Simon, but no promises.

As far as I know, there's nothing about those particular issues. Keep in mind though that they have their own internal bug tracker and their own sets of changes, so it's quite possible that a lot more than this will be fixed.

subject: The Bugzilla

subject: flatspin scores resetting

body: For what it's worth, not just the 360 that resets the totals when you crash, have had that issue several times in ps3 games too. There is at least one other challenge too, think it's total jump distance, that resets if anyone crashes.
